data.name: Miraj
data.gender_notes: Miraj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Miraj refers to the Night Journey of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) from Mecca to Jerusalem and then to the Seven Heavens as narrated in the Quran (Al-Isra' 17:1). This journey is a symbol of spiritual ascent and closeness to Allah. The name Miraj carries the meaning “The Night Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Miraj usually hope their child will grow to embody the night journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual ascent and closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Miraj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Night Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miraj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
